notes: recommendedLevelMin/Max = Blizzard's official range for the 9 new dungeons and the client Group Finder range (via Endgame Tools) for original dungeons.
minLevel = the door's entry level read from the client by WowForeverTalents; for the 9 new dungeons the door level is not readable so it equals the Blizzard minimum.
Raids are listed with availableNow=false until Dec 9, 2026.

Not included: Demon Fall Canyon, Karazhan Crypts, Manor Mistmantle and the old 40/20-player raids (Molten Core, BWL, ZG, AQ, Naxx). They exist in client data but Blizzard has not opened or announced them.

uncertain: Door entry level not readable from client; set to 13 (Group Finder minimum).
Wowhead names boss 2 'Magmatus'; the client and Endgame Tools say 'Infurnus'.
dungeons.name: The Hall of Thanes
dungeons.summary: Brand-new Forever dungeon under Ironforge, where the dwarven kings are buried. Dark Iron intruders have broken in and the dead are restless.
dungeons.specialMechanic: Entrance is inside Ironforge itself (about 27.8, 47.9), so Alliance groups can walk in from the capital.
tips: Our home-turf starter dungeon. Grab the quests in Ironforge first (An Ancient Grudge, Important Heirlooms, The Restless Dead).
Horde have to trek through Alliance land to get here, so expect mostly Alliance groups.

uncertain: Door entry level not readable from client; set to 15 (Group Finder minimum).
dungeons.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
dungeons.summary: New Forever dungeon in the ruined capital above the Undercity. The Forsaken are reclaiming it, the Scourge still haunts it, and a necromancer is gathering power.
dungeons.specialMechanic: Horde-side entrance (about 63.4, 67.4 in Tirisfal). Alliance can enter but must travel deep into Horde territory, and Alliance has fewer quests here.
tips: For us this is a road trip into Horde land on a Roleplaying realm; plan the route together.
Hall of Thanes covers the same levels much closer to home.

uncertain: Level range conflict: Blizzard article 24-29 (Oct 20) vs Blizzard beta notes 26-31 vs client Group Finder 26-33. Recommend 26-31 for graying if Aaron prefers the in-game numbers.
dungeons.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
dungeons.summary: New Forever dungeon above Whelgar's Excavation near Thelgen Rock and Dun Algaz. A strange mist, titan constructs and raptors guard a place frozen in time.
dungeons.specialMechanic: New roads lead up to it (entrance about 47.7, 56.2 in Wetlands).
tips: Alliance quests come from the Wetlands, for example Highland Hides for James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
Blizzard's beta notes moved this to 26-31 and the Group Finder lists 26-33; if you are 24-25 expect a tough run.

uncertain: Boss list differs slightly across sources (Wowhead also lists Arcanic Enigma; Endgame Tools says 9 bosses).
dungeons.name: City of Dalaran
dungeons.summary: New Forever dungeon. The barrier over Dalaran has fallen and the restored city is in arcane chaos: backfiring enchantments and runaway constructs.
dungeons.specialMechanic: Attunement required. Alliance starts with 'An Alarming Request' from Emissary Jacques in Southshore. You enter through the sewers and pick between several paths.
tips: Do the attunement chain before you post a group, or you will be stuck at the door.
Multiple routes inside, so agree on the route before the first pull.

uncertain: Boss order is from the DungeonJournal addon (player-maintained); client files still encrypted.

dungeons.name: The Drowned City
dungeons.zone: Stranglethorn Vale (off the coast, west of Grom'gol)
dungeons.summary: New Forever dungeon. Ancient troll ruins have risen from the sea; trolls and naga roam the streets next to a wrecked pirate ship.
dungeons.specialMechanic: Dive underwater to find the entrance. It is open-air inside and the weather builds into a full storm before the last boss.
tips: Bring water breathing or know your breath bar for the swim in.
The entrance is near Grom'gol, a Horde camp; watch out on the way.

dungeons.name: Krol'dok Stronghold
dungeons.summary: New Forever dungeon in the new Riverglades zone. Ogre raiders have been kidnapping travelers; follow them into a sprawling fortress of workshops, camps and guarded halls.
dungeons.specialMechanic: Large fortress with interior passages; Twilight's Hammer cultists are mixed in with the ogres.
tips: Alliance quest 'Eye of Mugg' comes from Commander Demar Brant at Farholde Keep in the Riverglades.
Listen for the chanting after dark; the story quests tie into it.

uncertain: Quest giver not confirmed. Warcraft Tavern lists in-game LFG range 48-55.
dungeons.name: Alcaz Prison
dungeons.summary: New Forever dungeon. The long-sealed prison on Alcaz Island is finally open, with the Defias Brotherhood and naga fighting inside, and rumors of King Varian's captivity.
dungeons.specialMechanic: Island off the northeast corner of Dustwallow Marsh, near Theramore.
tips: Big story dungeon for Alliance fans; the Varian mystery runs through it.
Alliance quest 'The Dragon's Journal' reportedly starts in Dalaran.

dungeons.name: Blackmaw Hold
dungeons.summary: New Forever max-level dungeon. A great furbolg city behind a long-sealed gate, fighting a corruption that spreads through its groves and tunnels.
dungeons.specialMechanic: Large, with multiple routes. One entrance to the Barrow Deeps raid (opens Dec 9) is inside Blackmaw Hold.
tips: Alliance druid-flavored quest 'Get to the Roots of It' comes from Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.
Great pre-raid stop for the Dec 9 raids.

dungeons.name: The Shaper's Terrace
dungeons.summary: New Forever max-level dungeon. An ancient titan facility above Un'Goro with dinosaurs, tar pits and powerful crystals.
dungeons.specialMechanic: Bring power crystals gathered around Un'Goro; consoles inside the terrace use them.
tips: Farm Un'Goro power crystals before the run so the consoles work.
Group Finder reportedly only lists it at 60; treat 58-59 as a stretch.
